cards.label: Demo — Hub
cards.text: The man at the counter has the look of someone who has answered these questions before and will answer them again.
He waits. The kettle does not.

cards.speaker: Landlord
cards.text: "Twelve months. Break clause if the roof does."

cards.speaker: Landlord
cards.text: "Quiet. Mostly. Number nine plays the cello at three in the morning."
You take the keys. They are warmer than they should be.
